title: This email I send to hotels 5 to 7 days before check in keeps getting us free treats and upgrades!
description:
This email I send to hotels 5 to 7 days before check in keeps getting us free treats and upgrades 🏨✨

Most families book their hotel…
Show up…
And hope for the best.

But after years of family travel, I stopped leaving it to chance.

Because traveling with kids is already a lot.

You want smoother check in.
More space.
Less stress.

A few trips ago, before a big overseas family vacation, I sent a simple email 6 days before arrival.

Nothing pushy.
Nothing entitled.

Just thoughtful.

When we arrived?

The kids had welcome cookies waiting.
Our standard room became a larger family room.
Late checkout was already noted without me asking again.

Daddy Barry looked at me and said, “Why doesn’t everyone do this?”

Here’s what I include in that email:

1️⃣ A warm intro
I introduce us as a family traveling with kids and say how excited we are to stay.

2️⃣ A small meaningful detail
If it’s a birthday, first trip overseas, or special milestone, I mention it.

3️⃣ A polite question
I kindly ask if there are any available family friendly room options or upgrades, understanding it depends on occupancy.

4️⃣ Appreciation in advance
Gratitude before arrival sets the tone.

This is one of our most powerful hotel hacks.

Interesting travel fact: Many hotels pre assign rooms 24 to 48 hours before arrival. Reaching out 5 to 7 days prior gives staff time to note preferences before final allocations.

It doesn’t work 100 percent of the time.

But it works often enough that we never skip it.

Better room layouts.
Sweeter welcomes.
Happier kids.

Family travel feels different when you prepare instead of react.

Save this for your next trip.
